tasks.title: Add CI provider config to repo-policy.json
tasks.description: Add a `ci` field to the Quaestor-Web entry in repo-policy.json. Shape: `{provider: "circleci", project_slug: "gh/Quaestor-Technologies/Quaestor-Web"}`. tasks.title: Build ci-fix SKILL.md
tasks.description: Create the ci-fix skill at ~/.dotfiles/claude-code-shared/skills/ci-fix/SKILL.md. Full diagnose-fix loop: check CircleCI MCP auth (hard-refuse if not authenticated), detect current branch from git, read repo-policy.json `ci` field for project slug (fall back to .circleci/config.yml), load CircleCI MCP debug-failing-run playbook via list_skills + get_skill, query CircleCI MCP (list_runs by branch -> list_run_workflows -> list_workflow_jobs -> get_job + get_job_logs/list_job_tests for failing jobs), diagnose each failure, apply code fixes, run local verification only for steps not covered by existing hooks (pytest, pyright, vitest, migration checks — lint/format rely on pre-commit hooks), push via gxpush --auto, output inline summary (mechanical fixes listed briefly, semantic fixes shown with diff and reasoning). Single commit, single push. One shot per invocation. Standard learning-capture tail block with slug ci-fix.
acceptance_criteria: Skill hard-refuses with guidance when CircleCI MCP is not authenticated
Skill reads repo-policy.json ci field for project slug with .circleci/config.yml fallback
Skill loads debug-failing-run playbook via list_skills + get_skill at start
CircleCI MCP query chain covers list_runs -> list_run_workflows -> list_workflow_jobs -> get_job_logs
Local verification runs only for non-hook-covered steps (pytest, pyright, vitest, migration checks)
Push delegates to gxpush --auto; skill stops and reports if local verification fails
Inline summary distinguishes mechanical fixes (brief) from semantic fixes (diff + reasoning)
Learning-capture tail block present with slug ci-fix
tasks.summary: Created ci-fix SKILL.md with 8-step flow: auth gate, playbook load, branch/slug detection, CI query chain, failure diagnosis, code fixes, local verification, gxpush --auto, and inline summary with mechanical vs semantic distinction.

tasks.title: Auto-monitoring mode: poll CI and auto-fix on failure
tasks.description:
Auto-monitoring mode: after push, skill polls CI via /loop dynamic mode and auto-fixes on failure. Infrastructure exists (ScheduleWakeup, /loop). Deferred to keep v1 simple as a standalone tool. Can wrap the skill in a polling layer later without changing its internals.

User confirmed interest. ~270s poll interval stays in cache. Needs trigger from gxpush or manual invocation. Retry cap and stop conditions TBD for that mode.
